title: TOCTOU in get_raw: stat then read with delete in between returns ReadFailed not None
description: rados_store.rs:get_raw calls rados_object_stat then rados_object_read. If the object is GC-deleted between the two calls, rados_object_read returns ENOENT, which is mapped to IpfsError::ReadFailed (not Ok(None)). The transit pipeline treats ReadFailed as a hard error (article lost), not a cache miss (re-fetch from peer). Fix: detect ENOENT in the read call and return Ok(None) for that case too. The stat+read pattern should handle ENOENT at both steps.
